title: Beef Tips
reject_reason: Cubed chuck beef tips simmered in beef-broth/French-onion gravy is the same dinner as live beef-tips-and-gravy-mashed-potatoes; beef + tips + gravy + braise all match, stovetop-vs-slowcooker is the only difference.
